title: Is it wrong to eat plants?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Do you think the ability to feel pain should determine whether something is morally acceptable to eat?
If future research suggested plants had more complex responses than we expected, would it change your diet?
Is it useful to compare the ethics of eating plants with the ethics of eating animals?
Can humans realistically avoid causing harm to living things when producing food?
What principle should guide food ethics when there is uncertainty about what other organisms can experience?
